text: Here, my mind oscillates between anticipation and contemplation. The glass-walled meeting room is silent, its emptiness filled with the promise of ideas yet to come. Moving into the vibrant R+D space, I feel stimulated by the colors, words, and the flow of innovation. There’s a sensation of being drawn into questions about existence and progress, as if each display gently nudges me to reflect on the continuous evolution of human thought. I am both an observer and a participant in this unfolding narrative of inquiry.
